title: Compress a resource-restricted measurement comparison to a finite faithful witness
status_authority: Completed working derivation supplied with original proof; no substantive completed review of this new result is claimed.
reported_status: Completed working derivation supplied with original proof; no substantive completed review of this new result is claimed.
scientific_scope_status: The completed working derivation gives resource-preserving reference dimension at most m+1 for a violating comparison of rational-complex measurement POVMs, where m counts nonzero numerator outcomes. PPT and separable uniform equal-reference entropy, reference-subtracted conditional entropy and zero-reference SLD comparisons are equivalent; faithful interior witnesses can also preserve both signal marginals. Failure lies in exists-R and order in co-exists-R contained in PSPACE.
